program = '''def transform(grid):
    # The image is a regular grid: the most common color is the cell fill,
    # while continuous non-fill rows and columns are grid lines.
    from collections import Counter
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    non_bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != background)
    separator = non_bg.most_common(1)[0][0]

    rows = [r for r in range(h) if all(v != background for v in grid[r])]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] != background for r in range(h))]
    marked_rows = [r for r in rows if any(grid[r][c] != separator for c in cols)]
    marked_cols = [c for c in cols if any(grid[r][c] != separator for r in rows)]

    out = []
    for r0, r1 in zip(marked_rows, marked_rows[1:]):
        row = []
        for c0, c1 in zip(marked_cols, marked_cols[1:]):
            corners = (grid[r0][c0], grid[r0][c1], grid[r1][c0], grid[r1][c1])
            if corners[0] == corners[1] == corners[2] == corners[3] and corners[0] != separator:
                row.append(corners[0])
            else:
                row.append(background)
        out.append(row)
    return out
'''
